query: SELECT c.frame->'event'->>'name' AS name, s.ts FROM events s JOIN events c ON c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.run_id = s.run_id AND c.frame->'event'->>'type' = 'tool.call' AND c.frame->'event'->>'call_id' = s.frame->'event'->>'call_id' WHERE s.conversation_id = $1 AND s.run_id = $2 AND s.step = $3 AND s.frame->'event'->>'type' = 'tool.start' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND e.run_id = s.run_id AND e.frame->'event'->>'type' = 'tool.end' AND e.frame->'event'->>'call_id' = s.frame->'event'->>'call_id') ORDER BY s.seq DESC LIMIT 1
